# ECU Tuning Service (AZ Performance) — client + admin design system

Kind: **service** · site-kind: **other** · radius: **soft** (8 / 12 / 20) · buttons: **solid** · dark tokens.
Both pages (client landing + order form at `/`, admin console at `/admin`) share this one system
(`public/styles.css`).

## Brand deal (generated by taste-skill)

```css
:root {
  --p-bg: #0d0d0f; --p-surface: #16161a; --p-ink: #f5f2e8; --p-muted: #9a948a;
  --p-accent: #f2c14e; --p-accent-ink: #0d0d0f; --p-action: #f2c14e; --p-action-ink: #0d0d0f;
  --p-inv-bg: #f5f2e8; --p-inv-surface: #e2dfd7; --p-inv-ink: #0d0d0f; --p-inv-muted: #5a5957;
  --font-display: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --font-text: "Schibsted Grotesk", system-ui, sans-serif;
  --display-weight: 400; --display-tracking: -0.035em;
}
```

Font loading (both pages): preconnect `fonts.googleapis.com` / `fonts.gstatic.com` +
`https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Schibsted+Grotesk:wght@400..700&display=swap`.

The `--p-*` tokens map to the legacy var names used by HTML/JS (`--bg`, `--surface`, `--text`,
`--muted`, `--accent`, `--gold`, `--dark-*`, `--gray-*`, `--border-color`, `--gradient-primary` = solid accent).
Never break those aliases: inline styles in `app.js`/`admin.js` and the form markup reference them.

## Typography

- One family: Schibsted Grotesk 400–700. Display = text = same family.
- Headings: weight 400, tracking −0.035em, sentence case, no uppercase labels.
- Scale (1440 / 390): h1 72/38 · h2 48/30 · h3 28/24 · card titles 20/18 · lead 20/18 ·
  body 16 · small 14 · labels 13/500 · stat 38/28. Fixed steps, no clamp() spam.

## Colour

- Flat grounds only: base `--p-bg`, surface `--p-surface`, raised `#1d1d21`. No gradients,
  glows, pattern grounds, scrims or coloured shadows anywhere.
- Ink hairlines: `--border` rgba(245,242,232,0.14), strong 0.26.
- One accent `#f2c14e` (< 3% of a screen): the primary button, links, focus ring, small marks
  (icons), the one brand band. No violet/lavender, ever.
- Status (admin console, same palette): success `#5ac98e`, warning `#f0a63c`, danger `#e0645a`, info `#7fb4d9`.

## Radius and buttons

- Soft scale: controls 8px, panels 12px, cards 20px, buttons 12px. Pills only for status chips.
- One button pair: `.btn-primary` (accent fill, accent-ink label) + `.btn-secondary`
  (transparent, hairline border). Admin status actions reuse the secondary shape and tint the
  label colour (`.btn-success/.btn-warning/.btn-danger`). Height 44px, label 16/500.
- Hover: fill steps 1px up (fine pointer only); press: 1px down + scale .985. 140ms in,
  200ms out, 90ms press. Exactly one filled button marks the main action per view.

## Motion

- `html[data-motion]` scopes the micro-interaction layer in `styles.css`.
- Allowed: card hover lift 2px + border step; button step/press; nav and link underlines
  drawing left→right; the modal fade. Nothing else moves: no entrance/orchestrated reveals,
  no counters, no infinite animations, no scroll-linked motion, no tilt.
- `prefers-reduced-motion: reduce` — everything rests; colour changes only.

## Layout

- One container: max-width 1280px, gutters 80/48/24px. Equal left and right content edges.
- Rhythm: `--nav` 72/56, `--padt` 120/96, `--padb` 72/48; every `main > section` at least one
  screen, section spacing via parent padding — no child margins, no divider bands.
- The hero fills the first screen alone (100svh), photograph full-bleed behind one solid
  panel holding the h1, one hard fact and the main action.
- Nav: fixed, opaque, 1px hairline below, plain word links with drawn underlines, the primary
  button on the right. Footer: brand + contact, one legal row.

## Copy

- h1 = category + buyer ("ECU tuning for every car"); one hard fact on the first screen
  ("12 services from 40 €"); buttons = verb + object ("Send your ECU file"); sentence case;
  no hype, no emoji. The French service catalog (12 services + prices) is printed exactly as
  given — never reworded.

## The nine house rules (condensed)

1. No caption or description under any image, render or visual.
2. Every visual renders, never an empty ground, at 1440 / 1024 / 768 / 390.
3. One section per screen: the hero alone on the first screen, sections 1–2 screens, no
   second section heading peeking in.
4. Equal left and right content edges.
5. Hover micro-animations only: linked card lifts 2px, buttons step and press, underlines
   draw. No tilt, carousels, timed tabs, scroll reveals.
6. Real photographs where they fit; flat grounds, better type.
7. Real full-colour icons only where a real brand/product icon applies; otherwise one set of
   1.5px line SVGs in currentColor.
8. No shader/creative effects on a service page.
9. Contacts: street and district only, no house number/postcode/coordinates/register numbers;
   (this site prints the client's real WhatsApp channel — kept intentionally).

## Functional contract (do not break)

- Form field names/ids in `index.html` (`customerName`, `customerEmail`, `customerPhone`,
  `vehicleInfo`, `ecuReference`, `service`, `customServiceDescription`, `ecuFile`) and the
  12 select options are the API contract of `POST /api/orders`.
- Admin flow (`admin.js`): login/logout via `/api/admin/login`, `/api/admin/logout`,
  session header `x-admin-session`, orders `GET /api/orders`, status `PUT /api/orders/:id/status`,
  modified upload `/api/orders/:id/modified`, downloads, delete — untouched.
- Icons are inline SVG (Lucide, ISC); no icon CDN, no icon files needed.
